brief.headline: Push for ₹66.48/KG (Sayaji's price) and qualify a second source — you're paying ₹1.26 Cr extra every year and they hold 56% of your Dextrose supply

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG — the price Sayaji Industries Limited already gives us for the same material
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji for Dextrose. Gujarat Ambuja charges us ₹68.45/KG — a 3.0% gap. The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG sits in the middle of the fair band and is a price we know works.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to stretch payment further right now

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja publishes no financial statements, so we can't see their revenue, profit or debt. That means we build our position from what we do know: they supply 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr spend), making us a big customer. We already have proof that ₹66.48/KG is achievable because Sayaji gives us that price today. With no visibility into their finances, the smart move is to line up a second qualified source — Tirupati, Gulshan or Sanstar — so we're not dependent and have real walk-away power.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹68.45/KG but Sayaji charges only ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
evidence.figure: ₹68.45/KG vs ₹66.48/KG, a 3.0% gap costing us ₹1.26 Cr per year

evidence.point: They are our dominant Dextrose supplier — more than half our volume comes from them
Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target sits in that fair range
India's export unit value for Dextrose is ₹42.95/kg — a floor showing there's room below our current price

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller that makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS at IV-fluid grade — exact form match; confirm IP monograph certificate of analysis before switching

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed starch and polyol maker, established dextrose and sorbitol supplier — described as a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja and Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist in starch and dextrose with growing capacity

risks: They supply 56% of our Dextrose — squeezing too hard without a qualified backup in place could leave us scrambling if they walk or ration supply
No public financials means we're flying blind on their health — if they're fragile we won't see it coming, so move fast on qualifying Tirupati, Gulshan or Sanstar
Sayaji at ₹66.48/KG proves the price is real, but if Gujarat Ambuja digs in we need a second source ready to RFQ immediately
The market asking price verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)' — our current ₹68.45/KG sits at the higher end, so there's room to push but not massive room
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹68.45/KG when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose — help us understand the gap and let's work toward that price.
